notes: User-specific custom override file for this HD-EMG system.
This file is intentionally separate from electrode_layout_default_128.json so the built-in physical array definition stays unchanged.
The reference_hdemg_layout section below records the physical channel grouping and stagger pattern for this array.
Start by editing global, per-column, or per-channel values here.
column_* arrays follow the 10 vertical HD-EMG columns.
channel_offsets_mm applies additive [dx, dy, dz] after column transforms.
channel_positions_mm replaces a channel with an absolute [x, y, z] position.
positions_mm can replace the entire default layout with explicit coordinates.
